messages:
maria: Noticed a regression in the daily analytics rollup this morning — several joins undercounted after last night's ETL retries. Looks like missing spans + reorder during retry. tagging folks to plan fixes and owners.
ashwin: i saw consumer offsets jump around 02:10-02:28 UTC, likely due to a transient K8s eviction. log snippet: 
```
2026-03-23T02:10:14Z ERROR consumer: lost heartbeat, group rebalance
2026-03-23T02:11:01Z WARN consumer: paused partitions [3,7]
2026-03-23T02:28:47Z INFO consumer: resumed partitions
```
leila: that pause aligns with the rollup window. when the join runs it expects sessions partition keys to be monotonic; reordering causes key lookups to miss and aggregator drops records. estimate initial impact ~2.7% of keys for last 24h.
sam: short term patch idea: add ingest_sequence and a compacting dedupe that tolerates out-of-order up to 15m watermark. i can prototype and land a small change w/ feature flag. ~10h work + 3h testing.
tom: sounds good. who will run the targeted replays/backfill? need to coordinate compute and run windows.
kai: I can run backfills this week but need a concrete list of affected partitions and time slices. ashwin, if you can surface partitions with lag > 5m that would let me scope cost.
ashwin: will add an alert on consumer-lag >5m and produce a partition-time map. ETA for alert + script: 2026-03-24 14:00 UTC.
oncall-bot: incident-log: "etl-join-order-regression" severity P3. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/etl-join-issues
maria: owners proposal: sam -> reorder-tolerant dedupe + feature flag (ETA 2026-03-25), ashwin -> consumer-lag alert + partition map (ETA 2026-03-24), kai -> execute backfill for affected windows (ETA 2026-03-26), leila -> validation suite + impacted-customer list (ETA 2026-03-24), tom -> post-fix verification and rollout plan (ETA 2026-03-26).
leila: validation plan (short): 1) replay rollup with fixed offsets, 2) compute key-hit ratio per bucket, 3) compare billing totals and top-customer diffs, 4) smoke test customer dashboards. i'll publish a notebook and link by EOD tomorrow.
sam: implementation detail: i will add unit tests for reordering scenarios and an integration job that injects synthetic out-of-order records. will keep change behind ff and monitor shadow rollup for 48h.
maria: we should also add a postmortem action to capture recurrence. this is the 2nd similar incident in last 60 days. propose a 6-week monitoring cadence and include runbook improvements to detect reordering earlier.
nashwin: agree. i'll start a lightweight recurring RCA thread (1x/week for 6 weeks) and assign to oncall rotation.
tom: ops ask: set an SLO on daily rollup delta vs shadow replay (target <0.5%). add dashboard for join-success and lag histogram. ops will own dashboard maintenance.
kai: once ashwin posts partition map i'll estimate backfill compute and schedule. prefer small replays for affected windows first, then full replay only if deltas persist.
maria: action item recap in thread: 
- sam: implement reorder-tolerant dedupe + FF (ETA 2026-03-25)
- ashwin: alert on consumer-lag >5m + partition-time map (ETA 2026-03-24)
- kai: run targeted backfills (ETA 2026-03-26)
- leila: publish validation notebook + impacted-customer list (ETA 2026-03-24)
- tom: verification plan & SLO/dashboard coordination (ETA 2026-03-26)
- maria/ashwin: start 6-week recurrence cadence (starts 2026-03-27)
please flag blockers here. i'll update the postmortem doc at https://redwood.internal/postmortems/etl-join-order-2026-03 as items progress. :white_check_mark:
